_meta.note: Derived file - regenerated from the HPI-CT workbooks (source of truth). Do not hand-edit. Public-source, personal-capacity work; all case figures reflect allegations/settlements as described in cited public documents, not findings of fact unless a court so determined.

diagnosis_matrix.signals: E&M level creep; modifier abuse; peer-percentile spikes
control_fixes: CB-03, PI-01 (formerly C-07) Claims Billing - coding-intensity outlier report vs peer baseline (Mod 03/06)
diagnosis_matrix.diagnostic_inputs: 1) Provider/service in scope for outlier review? 2) Peer-baseline coding-intensity report designed? 3) Run for the period & outliers worked (report + workpapers)? 4) Flagged outliers dispositioned with rationale? 5) Ran but this pattern missed = peer-group/threshold gap.
diagnosis_matrix.failure_mode_fix: Absent: no outlier report -> build CB-03. Not operating: not run/worked -> schedule + owner. Bypassed: outliers cleared no rationale -> require documented disposition. Ineffective: peer group/threshold loose -> re-tune.
